display_long_description:
Three games. One table.

Turn your table into a mixed-reality arcade with three solo games, colorful 3D boards, and a redesigned home hub.

CUBES - STACK AND CLEAR
Plan your placements, complete lines, and clear floors. Choose Classic, take a slower pace in Relaxed, or race the clock in a three-minute Sprint. Preview your next piece, hold one for later, and earn combo and floor-clear bonuses.

SNAKE - EAT AND GROW
Guide your cube snake toward food and grow your trail. Plan your turns, keep moving, and try to beat your personal best.

PONGO - BOUNCE AND AIM
Guide a moving paddle and steer the ball toward targets. Use tilt and rebounds to keep the rally alive.

A FRESH LOOK ACROSS THE COLLECTION
Dark boards, cyan grids, coordinated colors, and matching menus bring all three games together. Choose your next challenge through animated game previews, check personal bests, and compare rankings. Cubes online rankings apply to Classic mode.

Opening instructions, help and pause screens, clear results, and shared audio settings keep the focus on play.

Pick your game. Find your rhythm. Try for a new best.
